title: SealedBrowserCache
responsibility: Stores account-partitioned ciphertext, sealed enrollment keys and scope cursors in IndexedDB.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.open.account
inputs.description: Verified Google actor ID used to partition the browser cache.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.keys.scope
inputs.description: Opaque base64url scope ID from the signed device chain.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.keys.epoch
inputs.description: Scope key generation used to decrypt the envelope.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.objects.scope
inputs.description: Opaque base64url scope ID from the signed device chain.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.cursor.scope
inputs.description: Opaque base64url scope ID from the signed device chain.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.applyPage.scope
inputs.description: Opaque base64url scope ID from the signed device chain.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.applyPage.page
inputs.description: Scope cursor before and after this page, with its original ciphertext envelopes.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.saveEnrollment.enrollment
inputs.description: This browser device and the signed chain entries used to verify its access.

inputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.saveEnrollment.grants
inputs.description: Scope keys unwrapped and checked against the device chain’s signed commitments.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.open
outputs.description: Browser cache handle for the account partition.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.enrollment
outputs.description: Stored account device and chain, or undefined before approval.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.keys
outputs.description: Non-extractable scope keys for the requested epoch, or undefined.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.objects
outputs.description: Original object envelopes and their opaque revision metadata in the scope.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.cursor
outputs.description: Last committed scope change cursor, with zero for a new scope.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.applyPage
outputs.description: True when the page and its cursor committed together. False when another tab advanced first.

outputs.name: SealedBrowserCache.saveEnrollment
outputs.description: True when the verified chain and grants committed. False when the stored device or chain moved.
